caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden-framed object, resembling a picture frame or window, set against a plain, light beige background. The frame is oriented vertically and divided into two sections. The upper section contains an illustration of a red-brick, two-story house with a white front, two chimneys, and a peaked roof, surrounded by green trees, yellow fencing, and grassy terrain under a cloudy blue-gray sky. The lower section is largely blank, with a faint and diffuse depiction of a window or glass reflecting light, showing subtle tones of white, gray, and hints of blue. The lower right portion outside the frame includes the handwritten text "REMOVED MEMORIES" in small, gray letters.
title: Mirror
